verdict.rationale: Buzz supports voice huddles and agent search over channel history (e.g., buzz-gh-2 mentions dropping into voice huddles; buzz-gh-3 references agents searching six months of history), but there is no evidence of an AI-generated meeting notes/recap feature summarizing huddle audio or content for attendees or absentees. missing for 10: any documented transcript/summary generation from huddle audio, a recap artifact delivered to users, or evidence of catching up on missed huddles via AI notes.
